description.en: Even Paladin: Genn Greymane makes the Hero Power cost (1); Corpsetaker, Spikeridged Steed and Tirion Fordring hold the board. Source: nohandsgamer, #1 Legend, r/CompetitiveHS (Arctic Shift archive), March 2019.
